name: IEC photoelectric emitter interface: emitter - DC driven
aliases: photoelectric emitter interface Emitter - DC Driven
summary: Photoelectric emitter interface form: Emitter - DC Driven.
description: A photoelectric emitter supplies the light used by an optical sensing system; a complete sensing pair also needs a receiver. This entry identifies the emitter - dc driven form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A conveyor may place the emitter on one side and a separate receiver on the other so an object can interrupt the optical path. This is the DC-supplied form. Preserve supply polarity and confirm the output circuit type from the device wiring diagram.
A supply connection to an emitter is different from a switched detection output. Check the listed terminal and output form rather than assuming every optical device has the same interface.
